feature_policy.transformation: node-type one-hot plus log1p typed incidence/count features; canonical IDs and labels are never feature values.
feature_policy.unknown_is_not_zero_truth: A zero feature count means no observed edge in this view, not an explicit historical negative.

views.definition: Edges carrying the HG0 story layer; this is textual/participation structure, not a generic social tie.

Edges with review_status reviewed or candidate; epistemic state remains attached.

published_scope_boundary.historical_context_entity_policy: Include H0C-normalized Location/Event/Office/Clan/Regime nodes referenced by protected facts even when no current published Story edge exists.

published_scope_boundary.policy: Do not create dangling Story nodes. These links are an auditable research boundary until their canonical Story layer is in scope.
